 See all Stories
 Posted Nov 5, 2026 at 3:36 PM UTC S Stevie Bonifield Rockstar just released dozens of new GTA VI screenshots. Some of the shots in the new launch gallery look straight out of a movie , with new peeks at Jason, Lucia, and Leonida. GTA VI ’s launch is just two weeks away on November 19th, and players can start preloading it next week on November 10th.
